LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.0.label: Calibrate
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.0.descripti: Retains the chosen Sharpshooter evolution. Refinement: the extra distant-hit multiplier or piercing bonus damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.1.label: Steady Aim
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.1.descripti: Three ordinary hits on the same enemy from at least 8 cells leave a sight mark for 5 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A different eligible target or a 4-second gap resets progress. Close hits, bonus damage and abilities do not count. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.2.label: Change the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.2.descripti: Ordinary hits on two different enemies within 4 seconds from at least 8 cells mark the second for 4 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Repeated hits neither advance nor renew progress; close hits, bonus damage and abilities do not count. Refinement: mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.3.label: Pierce the Gap
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.3.descripti: A Sharpshooter ability hit spends the victim’s sight mark for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. No further bonus is dealt without a new mark. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.4.label: Suppress Aim
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.4.descripti: An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells spends a sight mark to delay the enemy’s current equipped-gun warmup by 0.3 seconds. Without a native gun warmup, keep the mark. Close hits, abilities and bonus damage do not spend it. Once per sight mark. Refinement: warmup delay. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.5.label: Step Back
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.5.descripti: An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells spends a line mark and records both positions for 4 seconds. Walk at least two steps, increasing distance from the recorded enemy cell by at least 2 cells, then hit that enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once per mark. Enemy movement does not move the reference cell; teleporting cancels the opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.6.label: Relay Shot
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.6.descripti: An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells spends a line mark to open a 4-second relay. Another player colonist’s ordinary hit on that enemy triggers 50 extra damage attributed to the author, once per round. The author, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. A new relay replaces the author’s previous opportunity. Only actual bonus damage counts as a completed relay. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.7.label: Lingering Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.7.descripti: Actual Pierce the Gap damage records its firing line for 4 seconds. An ordinary hit on a different enemy from at least 8 cells deals 50 extra damage to the enemy nearest the old line within 1 cell, once, excluding the new trigger victim. Neither end follows movement. With no enemy near the line, keep the original deadline. Abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.8.label: Cut the Shot
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.8.descripti: Actually delaying a shot with Suppress Aim opens a 3-second opportunity. An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells on a different enemy warming up its equipped gun deals 50 extra damage, once. Without an eligible warmup, keep the remaining opportunity. A new Suppress Aim replaces it; abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.9.label: Return Fire
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.9.descripti: Actual Step Back bonus damage opens a 4-second return opportunity. Walk at least one step to within 1 cell of the original firing position, then hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells to mend 20 points of your non-permanent injuries, once. With no eligible injury, keep the remaining opportunity. Teleporting cancels it; abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.10.label: Covering Fire
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.10.descript: Actual Relay Shot bonus damage grants its partner a 25-point shield for 3 seconds. Its first actual absorption of enemy damage gives the author 3 seconds to hit the original relay victim ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once per round. Other shields, abilities and bonus damage do not trigger it. An existing shield from this source on that partner retains its original budget and opportunity. The author keeps only the latest successfully granted cover opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage and shield strength. Base rewards: damage 50; shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.11.label: Split the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.11.descript: Actual Lingering Line damage opens a 3-second split opportunity. Walk at least one step, move at least 1 cell from the trigger position and more than 1 cell from the old line, then hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once. Standing still, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it; teleporting cancels it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.12.label: Guard the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.12.descript: Actual Lingering Line damage grants a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds to the other eligible player colonist nearest the old line within 1 cell, once. Without an eligible ally, the author instead receives 25 shield point. Zero actual line damage grants no shield, and this shield cannot restart the line. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.13.label: Break Their Rhythm
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.13.descript: Actual Cut the Shot damage opens a 3-second follow-up. An ordinary hit from at least 8 cells on another enemy warming up its equipped gun delays that warmup by 0.3 seconds, once. Without an eligible warmup, keep the remaining opportunity. This delay cannot start a new Cut the Shot or follow-up. Refinement: warmup delay. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.14.label: Brace the Stock
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.14.descript: Actual Cut the Shot damage grants the author a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. No shield is granted without actual cut damage. This shield cannot start relay or cover replies. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.15.label: Take Position Again
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.15.descript: Actual Return Fire healing opens a 3-second pursuit. Walk at least one step and at least 1 cell from the healing position, then hit the original Step Back enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells for 50 extra damage, once. Standing still, other victims, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it; teleporting cancels it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.16.label: Mutual Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.16.descript: Actual Return Fire healing opens a 3-second support opportunity. Hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells to heal 20 points on the other player colonist with the most non-permanent injury within 4 cells, once. The author and permanent injuries are excluded. Without an eligible patient, keep the original deadline. Abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.17.label: Close the Gap
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.17.descript: Actual Covering Fire reply damage grants its original relay partner a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. This shield cannot reopen the cover reply. No shield is granted if the reply deals no actual damage. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.18.label: Cross Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Marksman.nodes.18.descript: Actual Covering Fire reply damage records the author and original partner positions for 4 seconds. Walk at least two steps, move at least 2 cells from the start and increase distance from the recorded partner position by at least 2 cells, then hit a different enemy ordinarily from at least 8 cells. The nearest third colonist within 4 cells receives a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once. The author and original partner are excluded. With no eligible recipient, keep the remaining opportunity; teleporting cancels it. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
